name: CANVAS
summary: Documents and canvases you and an agent can assemble and mark up together. Every drawing stays attached to a named element.

surface.hint: paste images into a document or canvas, arrange them, and share structured annotations with an agent

_rename_note: WAS `artifacts`. The word collided with Claude's own artifacts, which is a real cost in a studio you drive by talking to agents: two different things called the same name in the same sentence. The PROVIDER keeps its name and its verbs — @openrig/studio-artifacts, /api/artifacts*, the /artifacts/ byte route and the `artifacts` root kind are all unchanged, because they describe what is STORED (saved views, marks, assets) rather than what the surface is CALLED. An app is a label on a rail; a verb is a contract with every consumer.
